title: orchis morio f. alba
intro: Orchis morio f. alba, commonly known as the White Military Orchid, is a subspecies of the Orchis morio plant, a type of terrestrial orchid. This plant is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties to alleviate pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Orchis morio f. alba include expectorant and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential remedy for conditions like asthma and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
